'''Altars''' are a [[furniture]] item used in [[temple]]s.  In fortress mode, altars can be made from most materials, like wood at a [[Carpenter's workshop]], stone at a [[Mason's workshop]] (although using the [[Stonecrafter]] labor), glass at a [[Glass furnace]]/[[Magma glass furnace]] and metal at a [[Metalsmith's forge]]/[[Magma forge]]. They can be built with {{k|b}}-{{k|Alt|a}} labeled as '''Offering Places''', although they currently serve no purpose other than increasing a [[temple]]'s value and decoration, as temples don't require them to function.

In [[adventure mode]], you can often find [[dice]] that can be rolled on altars.
